text:
jordan: quick heads up — Marta's 2024-09 payrun shows Italian INPS and IRPEF taken for the 6/24–8/06 Milan short assignment, but the assignment letter specified US payroll retention under totalization. Can we reverse the INPS and reissue docs so W-2 isn't affected?

marta: that's me — I never wanted to switch to Italian payroll. assignment letter + approval are on the HR drive. i reported this when i saw the stub.

alex-peopleops: thanks — can you paste the payrun id and a screenshot of the stub here? we need payrun id, dates, and proof of assignment retention to send to payroll ops.

marta: payrun id: PR-20240915-78901. stub excerpt below:
```
emp_id: 78901
period: 2024-09-15
gross_pay: 8500.00
italian_tax_withheld: 1275.00 (IRPEF 15%)
inps_employee: 620.00
inps_employer: 930.00
us_federal_withheld: 1870.00
notes: flagged location=MILAN secondment
```

payroll-bot: Payrun PR-20240915-78901 processed at 2024-09-15T23:02:11Z by payroll-runner-3. Ticket previously not created.

liam-finance: tagging in finance — this is a double contributions issue. If Marta remained on US payroll under the totalization agreement we should: 1) reverse employee INPS and employer INPS contributions in the Italian payroll, 2) file refund claim with INPS (employer usually files), 3) run off-cycle reversal on our US payroll so W-2 boxes only reflect US withholdings, and 4) generate a written certificate for Marta she can use for Italian refund. Need to act before year-end to avoid W-2 complications.

alex-peopleops: list of docs we need from Marta to start reversal: assignment letter (signed), copy of PO/approval showing payroll retention, the paystub (screenshot) and confirmation of dates/days worked in Italy. Also we need the local HR rep in Milan to confirm no local contract onboarding occurred.

marta: i uploaded assignment_letter_marta_milan.pdf and stub_screens_marta.zip to the HR drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/hr/marta/milan-2024. Milan HR contact is luca.rossi@partner.co — he helped coordinate housing.

liam-finance: ok i'll open a PR ticket with payroll ops and INPS refund routing. owner: liam-finance. ticket: PR-8342 (internal). Action plan: 1) payroll ops to prepare reversal XML to both our Italian payroll provider and our GL, 2) benefits to adjust any pension/benefit contributions triggered by INPS, 3) people-ops to confirm assignment docs, 4) finance to prepare employer refund filing.

alex-peopleops: note — benefits engine saw INPS deductions and flagged supplemental pension enrollment; benefits team, pls hold any changes to eligibilities until payroll reversal completes.

payroll-bot: Ticket PR-8342 created by liam-finance at 2024-09-16T09:14:05Z. Linked resources: PR-20240915-78901 export.

jordan: good. can someone confirm expected delta on Marta's net and whether PTO payout was affected? stub looked like a lumped supplemental payout.

liam-finance: preliminary calc — removing employee INPS (620) and IRPEF (1275) will increase net by ~1895, but we'll also reconcile US withholding if duplication occurred. PTO payout line was processed as taxable in both systems; payroll ops to confirm exact gross reclassification.

alex-peopleops: i'll ask payroll ops to prioritize a reversal before the next cycle. if reversal can't clear before year-end, we need a W-2 memo explaining the correction and a plan for issuing a corrected W-2 (W-2c).

marta: appreciate it. any idea how long INPS refund typically takes? i don't want to be chasing this for 6+ months. :grimacing:

liam-finance: refund with INPS usually takes months; employer-driven claims can be faster but still 2–4 months. we'll provide a certificate to you to claim any direct refunds, and finance will track employer reclaim.

alex-peopleops: next steps checklist (short):
- Marta: confirm uploaded docs (done)
- Milan HR (Luca): confirm no local contract (assigned to alex-peopleops)
- Payroll Ops: prepare reversal + off-cycle (assigned)
- Benefits: pause any automatic benefit changes (assigned)
- Finance (liam): open PR-8342 + INPS refund filing (assigned)

jordan: thanks team. tagging #eng-peopleops-payroll so ops sees visibility. :thumbsup:

marta: thanks all — keep me posted here or DM.
